result:
T-DG3-BE-A is complete, including the "first change", and every required check passes; the one exception is `pnpm format:check`, explained below. I made no commits. The handback is at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG3/T-DG3-BE-A-backend-workflow-engineer.md`, with logs in `T-DG3-BE-A-evidence/`. The run took 22:02:38 to 22:38 UTC.

**Migration:** `0025_p3_g1_agreement_guard.sql`. It adds a deferred trigger, `gate_decision_g1_agreements`: an approved G1 decision without exactly three agreement rows is refused at COMMIT. It also replaces `p3_instantiate_transformation()` to fix an audit-format defect in the frozen `0024` (see below). Migrations `0001`→`0025` apply on a fresh database.

**Endpoints added:**
- `GET …/transformations/{id}/readiness`
- `GET …/transformations/{id}/outcome-hierarchy`
- `GET` and `POST …/gate-dispensations`, plus `…/{dispensationId}/decision` and `…/revoke`
- `decideGate` now requires the G1 `agreements`. Missing, partial or false confirmations get 422 `gate.g1_agreements_required` with one pointer per missing confirmation. Sending them on another gate or outcome gets 422 `gate.agreements_not_applicable`. The check runs after 404/403/403/409, so those keep their precedence.

**Checks:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG2` | PASS, exit 0 (at start and end) |
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm openapi:lint` | exit 0 (270 operations) |
| `pnpm format:check` | exit 2: permission denied on the sandbox's untracked root files |
| Assignment's prettier fallback (`git ls-files … prettier --check`) | exit 0 |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset | 946/946, exit 0 |
| `pnpm test`, `C.UTF-8` | 946/946, exit 0 |
| `with-pg.sh pnpm test:integration` (port 23116) | 638/638 in 42 files, exit 0 |

Earlier failing runs are disclosed and their logs kept. Two integration runs failed on the audit defect and on old P2 audit counts. One unit run failed on module-boundary rules, which I fixed. A web test, `session-identity.test.tsx`, also failed once under full load; I didn't change `apps/web`, and it passed alone (18/18) and in both final runs.

**Pinned counts:** the media-type triple goes from `[87, 86, 1]` to `[90, 89, 1]`, and the rate-limit floor from `>= 161` to `>= 167`.

**Problem in the frozen inputs:** `0024`'s `p3_instantiate_transformation()` writes its audit `changes` as `{"weights": {…}}` instead of `{from, to}`. Once `POST /transformations` switched to it, `GET /transformations/{id}/audit` failed contract validation. I fixed the function in `0025`. Rows already written by `0024`'s backfill on upgraded databases keep the old format, because the audit log is append-only. I reported this as proposed finding F-DG3-BE-A-1 (Medium); the architect or orchestrator should decide whether the audit read needs to tolerate those rows. Separately, ADR-0021 §5 calls the dispensation route `…/accept`, but the frozen contract uses `…/decision`; I followed the contract. No contract change is requested.

**Edits outside my listed files**, each forced by an assigned change and listed in the handback for confirmation:
- `packages/shared/src/schemas/gate.ts`: the request and response schemas are strict and needed `agreements`.
- `workflows/index.ts`: the only way to pass in the G4 fact provider and export `isGateApprover`.
- `workflows.test.ts` and `server.test.ts`: their pinned export and module lists.
- `registers.test.ts` and `transformations.test.ts`: they assume 24 audited rows per new transformation; it's now 29.

**Open points:**
- The kpi half of the G4 fact provider isn't wired. KBE-C's loader doesn't exist yet and KBE-C may not edit `server.ts`, so one line there needs changing when it lands.
- Dispensation decisions on someone's behalf (`onBehalfOfUserId`) are refused with a declared 422. That was my design choice, so no delegation path can loop back to an approval.

**e2e tests FE-A must update:** in `apps/web/e2e/p2-journeys.spec.ts`, the test "Gates: the approver's decision — 409 when the submission was superseded, then approval with a rationale" approves G1 through the dialog in `GateDetailPage.tsx`. It will now get 422 until the dialog sends the three agreements. No `tests/qa/**` suite approves G1.
